note: Discord Magneto optional effects (made for 1.1.3913745, moved onto 1.1.3962284). Offsets are in the legacy .uasset/.uexp that retoc-rivals-cli unpack --full-iostore-check gives (the patched assets in patched_sources, each from the newest patch that carries it, through a small carrier container, see 'unpack'). Colours: 'map' names the mapping (discord = the approved Discord blurple mapping, resonance / mr = the Magnetic Resonance version (teal/cyan too, pale yellow to Discord white), mc = the Metallic Chaos version (Scarlet Witch's hot pinks and reds stay), white = Discord white #F2F3F5 at the same HDR level, discord_keep_r = discord with the red channel vanilla, for colours enemies see through a pure red particle); 'new' / 'new_sha1' / 'expect' are what the mapping gives, the build checks its own maths against them. vm colours with 'set' are hand-picked values (pure blue where a channel is wired to zero, etc.). Material colours carry the exact original float32 bytes (old_hex) and are mapped from them. Every original is checked before it is changed, so a game update stops the build. A clone may carry 'vm' (a copied Niagara system: its script edits are applied to the copy). The pak is colour-only: materials, colour atlases, Niagara systems and the meshes that carry a Magneto-only material; the build refuses animation, montage, sequence, blueprint, ability, cue and table assets.
